    github_ref = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REF", "")

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

# Width of the horizontal ruler printed around the reproduction block.

# Parameters that only make sense in the context in which Breeze runs and should never be
# emitted as part of a local reproduction command.
_EXCLUDED_PARAMETERS = frozenset(
    {"verbose", "dry_run", "answer", "include_success_outputs", "debug_resources"}
)

# Sources that indicate the user explicitly provided a value for a parameter.
_EXPLICIT_SOURCES = frozenset(
    {ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE, ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT, ParameterSource.PROMPT}
)


@dataclass
class ReproductionCommand:
    """A single shell command (with an optional comment) used to reproduce CI locally."""

    argv: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    comment: str | None = None


def should_print_local_reproduction() -> bool:
    """Return ``True`` only when running inside a GitHub Actions CI environment."""
    return (
        os.environ.get("CI", "").lower() == "true"
        and os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS", "").lower() == "true"
    )


def build_ci_image_reproduction_command(
    *,
    github_repository: str = APACHE_AIRFLOW_GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
    platform: str = "linux/amd64",
    python: str = "",
) -> ReproductionCommand:
    """Build the command that rebuilds the CI image locally."""
    argv = ["breeze", "ci-image", "build"]
    if github_repository != APACHE_AIRFLOW_GITHUB_REPOSITORY:
        argv += ["--github-repository", github_repository]
    argv += ["--platform", platform]
    argv += ["--python", python]
    return ReproductionCommand(argv=argv, comment="Build the CI image locally")


def build_checkout_reproduction_commands(github_repository: str) -> list[ReproductionCommand]:
    """Build the git command(s) that check out the exact same code CI used."""
    github_ref = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REF", "")
    github_sha = os.environ.get("GITHUB_SHA", "")
    commands: list[ReproductionCommand] = []
    match = _PULL_REQUEST_REF_RE.match(github_ref) if github_ref else None
    if match:
        number = match.group("number")
        kind = match.group("kind")
        commands.append(
            ReproductionCommand(
                argv=[
                    "git",
                    "fetch",
                    f"https://github.com/{github_repository}.git",
                    github_ref,
                ],
                comment=(
                    f"Fetch the same code as CI (pull request {kind} ref) "
                    f"— or: gh pr checkout {number}"

    return commands

    lines: list[str] = []

            lines.append(f"# {step}. {command.comment}")
        lines.append(" ".join(command.argv))
